guide.title: Company guide
guide.subtitle: How companies & roles work
guide.createTitle: 1. Create your own company (not demo data)
guide.createBody: Open Settings → Company → "Create your company". Enter the company name and your display name. The app generates a real company id (org_…) and cryptographic keys (X25519 + Ed25519) locally — you become the first Admin. Nothing here is mock data: the workspace now shows YOUR company, stored on your device (IndexedDB).
guide.inviteBody: An Admin opens the company view → "Invite members" and shares the QR code. The QR is signed with the admin’s key and contains the org id, an invite code and the admin signature. A teammate scans it and sends a join request signed with their own Ed25519 key.
guide.confirmBody: A new joiner is given the "Member" role by default. The Admin verifies the invite signature and confirms the join (delivering the group key). To turn a member into an Admin or Manager: open the member card → Role → "Make admin" / "Make manager" / "Make member". Only Admins can change roles. Managers can manage members but cannot promote or demote Admins. Promotion is always confirmed explicitly by an Admin — there is no automatic admin/manager assignment.
guide.keysBody: Every join request is signed (Ed25519) by the joiner and the invite by the Admin. The Admin’s acknowledgement wraps the shared group key to the joiner’s device key (X25519). This means a member only becomes part of the company after an Admin validates the signature and sends the key — that is the confirmation step. Role changes are recorded and shown next to each member.
guide.note1: The first person to create a company is its Admin
guide.note2: Only an Admin can confirm or change someone’s role
guide.note3: Joining always requires the Admin’s signed invite

landing.heroSubtitle: Peer-to-peer encrypted messaging, decentralized identity, and mesh networking. Built for privacy, designed for freedom.
landing.featureEncryptedDesc: End-to-end encrypted conversations with perfect forward secrecy. No metadata, no tracking.
landing.featureMeshDesc: Direct peer-to-peer connections and relay fallback. Your data never touches centralized servers.
landing.featureZeroDesc: We cannot read your messages. We cannot recover your keys. Your privacy is by design, not policy.
landing.featureDecentralizedDesc: Self-sovereign identity with no phone number, no email, no central authority required.
landing.securityE2eeDesc: X25519 + AEAD-256. Perfect forward secrecy. Your keys never leave your device.
landing.securityMetadataDesc: No message timestamps, no IP logging, no contact graph harvesting. Nothing to leak.
landing.securityOpenDesc: Full source transparency. Independent audits. No backdoors, no compromises.
landing.ctaSubtitle: No signup required. No data collection. Just download and connect.
landing.copyright: © 2026 Mess&Anger. Open source. No data collection. No tracking.

mesh.title: LAN Mesh
mesh.hint: Serverless peer-to-peer: two devices on the same network exchange an invite QR and an answer QR. No signaling server involved — the session is encrypted with an ephemeral ECDH (X25519) + AES-GCM key pair derived locally on both sides.
